## Checklist

- [ ] `flutter analyze`, `flutter test` and backend `pytest` pass
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] No ads, trackers, analytics SDKs or new data sharing
- [ ] Medical wording stays "watch for / call if / this is common", never a diagnosis
- [ ] Learn card text unchanged, or a clinician review is linked
